name: mirage
text:
v1.0.48 is released (4,155 tests passed). It holds the live tennis fix: the live lane now always reads ATP/WTA when live tennis is on, plus the lane's counts on the Live tab. The engine is still outside its 8am-1am ET hours, so tennis starts showing once it runs at 8am ET.
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.48
